place_fields.vibe: lush forest waterfall and short trek
place_fields.summary: Waterfall in the Chikkle village forest area near Jamboti in Khanapur taluk, reached by a short walk/trek from the village.

planning_attributes.description: Chikhale Waterfall is listed at Chikkle village, Khanapur taluk forest area, Jamboti, Karnataka.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Reach Chikkle village in the Jamboti area; visitor reports describe the falls as about 2.5 km from the village, with a walking section after parking and no public transport reported.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Located in a forest area; local access conditions should be checked before travel.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The approach is a forest walk/short trek and can be muddy or slippery during the monsoon.
planning_attributes.notes: Trip.com and Yappe identify the same Chikkle village/Khanapur/Jamboti location.

place_fields.summary: A small lake attraction listed as Black Hole Lake in the Belagavi area; public listings place it near an unnamed road in the 591143 postal area.

planning_attributes.description: Black Hole Lake is listed as a tourist attraction near Belagavi; Trip.com gives the address WF6R+44H, Unnamed Road, Karnataka 591143, while another listing places it in Kangrali Kh, Belgaum.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Trip.com lists WF6R+44H on an unnamed road in Karnataka 591143; use the supplied coordinates for navigation rather than inventing a different coordinate.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: A public review listing reports poor water quality and explicitly says swimming is not allowed.
planning_attributes.notes: The name and Belagavi-area identity are corroborated by multiple public listings, but detailed natural-history information is limited.
